rubrics.justification: Generally captures a blastocyst with strong ICM and weaker TE, but shows uncertainty/confusion about Gardner expansion staging and gives some inconsistent TE characterization (B vs bordering C).
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, BMI, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status well, though some links to embryo-specific prognosis are somewhat generalized.

Contains notable internal inconsistencies: calls the embryo both good-quality and poor-quality, questions the reported grading, and the implantation estimate is lower than expected for a 30-year-old with a day-5 2AB embryo without fully reconciling why.

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer, avoiding routine add-ons, and selective PGT-A discussion, but the Gardner grading discussion is confused and some comments about fresh vs freeze-all and embryo quality are not tightly evidence-based.
Provides practical recommendations including single embryo transfer, luteal support, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, lifestyle optimization, and sensible future workup if unsuccessful.
